messages:
mira: Heads-up: I ran into a docs/runtime mismatch for /v1/ingest when demoing the API. The API now returns a nested error object and the request param name changed from `prefill` -> `prefetch`. The current reference still shows the old shapes and snippets.
jasper: Thanks, can you paste the exact staging response you saw?
mira: Sure, from curl against staging:
```http
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"message":"invalid payload: missing source","code":422}}
```
jasper: Yup, that's different from the docs which show `{"error_message":"..."}` and use `prefill: true` in request examples. That explains the failing Python snippet in the quickstart.
qa-bot: Flagged: docs vs runtime mismatch detected for endpoint /v1/ingest (examples, request params). Suggest: patch OpenAPI examples + update SDK snippet templates.
docsy: I'll open a PR to fix the OpenAPI example and snippet templates. Plan: (1) update request sample to use `prefetch`, (2) replace flat `error_message` example with nested `error` object, (3) update Python/JS snippets to check `resp.get('error')` / `if (resp.error) console.error(resp.error.message)`.
mira: Also please add a small "Migration notes" entry under the API reference and a one-line changelog so external integrators see the rename.\as docsy: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 — includes updated examples, snippet templates, and a short breaking-change note mapping `prefill -> prefetch`.
jasper: Nice. Can you include a short Python snippet showing robust parsing? e.g. `err = resp.get("error"); if err: raise RuntimeError(err.get("message"))`
docsy: Added the Python example and JS one-liner in the PR. Also fixed a few other stale quickstarts that still referenced `prefill`.
qa-bot: CI: docs-linter run queued for PR #5123.
docsy: Ran the linter locally, found one remaining example in docs/snippets/legacy.md referencing `error_message`. I updated that occurrence and pushed a follow-up commit.
qa-bot: CI: docs-linter passed for PR #5123 — https://ci.redwood.ai/13599
jasper: After merge we need SDK regen: I'll take JS, Mira can take Python. Also add a note to the SDK release checklist that snippets must match OpenAPI examples.
mira: I'll regenerate Python client and run unit tests against staging after the merge. If all good, I'll publish a patch (0.8.x).
docsy: Merged and preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/ingest now shows `prefetch` in request samples and a nested `error` object in examples.
mira: Verified locally against staging and the regenerated Python client parses the sample as expected. Closing the loop.
